Subject: Request: short-term credit top-up for scale validation run

Hi Jordan,

We're gearing up for a short POC scale run to validate latency and throughput for our chat-processing pipeline. The test window is Nov 20–22 (48 hours), and we expect a peak concurrency of ~75 QPS with steady-state ~40 QPS. Total estimate is ~320k inference tokens (we measured with a representative prompt set) — would need a short-term credit top-up or trial extension to cover that.

Attached is the loadtest_spec.xlsx with the traffic profile and success criteria.

Questions:
- Can Redwood provision a promotional top-up for this 48-hour window?
- Any rate limits or burst quotas we should be aware of?

This is an important milestone for our internal evaluation; if you can approve a sprint-sized top-up we can execute next week and share detailed metrics.

Cheers,
Liam
Senior Platform Engineer
Acme Analytics
liam@acmeanalytics.com
